verdict.rationale: Zoho Invoice is a SaaS product, so official SDKs are a fair axis to ask about. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an official SDK or client library. The probes found only a 404 at an API v3 docs path and no OpenAPI spec, and the native integrations with Zoho CRM and Books are adjacent features, not SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
